card.name: Words before a comparison sign in lab ranges
card.fires_on: Small words like "to", "and" or an opening parenthesis right before a threshold written with ≥, ≤, < or >, in lab-shift tables and renal-function dose tables. Also fires on "cr" in CLcr before a < sign.

modes.label: Shift from normal to high
modes.description: The word "to" or "(" after a normal range, just before a ≥ cutoff for the high range.

modes.label: Creatinine clearance ranges
modes.description: "and" after a lower bound such as CrCl >50, just before a ≤ upper bound.

card.writes: It promotes comparison symbols such as >, <, ≥ and ≤, so a numeric threshold comes next.
card.plain: It fires where a lab or kidney-function range is about to get a greater-than or less-than sign.
